اقتبستا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَبَسَتَا (iqtabasatā) /iq.ta.ba.sa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# اُقْتُبِسَتَا (uqtubisatā) /uq.tu.bi.sa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
